note: Candidate data, models, vocabularies and libraries for the roof-storey planner. 'checked' = read on the web by the Real2Twin notes (29 Oct 2026); 'to verify' = from memory, confirm the repository, weights and licence before citing. 'where' says what is known about the GX10 server (Real2Twin container) and is confirmed only by the inventory notebook.

tracks.recognise: Read a plan image into rooms

sources.name: CubiCasa5K
sources.what: 5,000 annotated floor plans with a pretrained multi-task network for rooms, walls, doors, windows and icons
sources.use: Segment a plan image into rooms; first real plan data

sources.name: DeepFloorplan (Raster-to-Vector)
sources.what: Older network for walls and room types from a raster plan
sources.use: Comparison against CubiCasa5K

sources.name: Qwen-VL class vision-language model
sources.what: Reads a plan image and answers with room names and rough layout as JSON, no training
sources.use: Fastest route to import a plan; needs a model that accepts images behind the server's vllm
sources.where: vllm and Open WebUI run on the server; whether a vision model is served is unknown

sources.name: Segment Anything (SAM)
sources.what: Prompt-free or prompted masks for any region
sources.use: Cut rooms, walls and the roof outline out of plan images and photos
sources.where: available through transformers in the Real2Twin image

sources.name: Grounding DINO
sources.what: Finds objects from a text prompt (for example 'dormer', 'stair')
sources.use: Label what SAM cuts out
sources.where: available through transformers in the Real2Twin image

sources.name: DINOv3
sources.what: General image features
sources.use: Similarity search over plans and roofs
sources.where: available through transformers in the Real2Twin image

sources.name: RPLAN
sources.what: About 80,000 residential floor plans
sources.use: Training data of most plan generators; access is restricted

sources.name: Modified Swiss Dwellings (MSD)
sources.what: Thousands of dwelling plans with structure and access graphs
sources.use: Plans with circulation, to compare with our access graph

sources.name: House-GAN / House-GAN++
sources.what: Bubble diagram to floor plan with a GAN
sources.use: Comparison with our rule-based builder

sources.name: HouseDiffusion
sources.what: Bubble diagram to floor plan with diffusion
sources.use: Comparison with our rule-based builder

sources.name: Graph2Plan
sources.what: Layout graph to floor plan
sources.use: Comparison with our rule-based builder

sources.name: Tell2Design
sources.what: Plans generated from language descriptions
sources.use: Text to plan; reference for an LLM front end

sources.name: ATISS
sources.what: Scene synthesis for furnished rooms, trained on 3D-FRONT (flat ceilings)
sources.use: Shows what is missing: it knows nothing about slopes

sources.name: DiffuScene
sources.what: Diffusion for indoor scenes
sources.use: Same comparison as ATISS

sources.name: NRW LoD2 building models
sources.what: Open 3D building models of North Rhine-Westphalia with roof shapes
sources.use: Roof types for the site, including Detmold

sources.name: RoofN3D
sources.what: Roof point clouds labelled by roof type
sources.use: Roof-type recognition

sources.name: ALKIS / AdV GeoInfoDok
sources.what: German official cadastre: object type and function keys
sources.use: Site and building function attributes

sources.name: INSPIRE Buildings 3.0
sources.what: Building feature themes, code lists and identifier pattern
sources.use: Identifier pattern; building classes

sources.name: CityGML 3.0
sources.what: City objects with levels of detail and code lists
sources.use: One building, several representations

sources.name: BauNVO and XPlanung
sources.what: German legal area types with permitted uses, GRZ and GFZ
sources.use: What may be built on the chosen site

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.what: Open map data: buildings, roads, land use
sources.use: Site context where ALKIS is not at hand

sources.name: momepy and spatial signatures
sources.what: Urban form measures and classification
sources.use: Describe the neighbourhood of the site

sources.name: Getty Art & Architecture Thesaurus
sources.what: 55,000 concepts, multilingual linked open data
sources.use: Terms for roofs, rooms and materials, with German labels where they exist
sources.where: notebook 02 of the Real2Twin smoke tests loads a subset

sources.name: AAT-Deutsch
sources.what: German translation of the AAT, object facet first
sources.use: German labels
sources.license: no licence stated: ask the project

sources.name: FISH thesauri
sources.what: Building components and monument types (Historic England)
sources.use: Roof and building components

sources.name: GEMET
sources.what: Environmental and urban terms in 37 languages
sources.use: Urban concepts in German and English

sources.name: Landesbauordnung NRW (BauO NRW)
sources.what: Building code of North Rhine-Westphalia: living rooms in the roof, escape routes, stairs
sources.use: Rules as versioned data; every threshold cited

sources.name: Wohnflächenverordnung (WoFlV)
sources.what: How living area under a slope is counted
sources.use: Basis of the 100 / 50 / 0 % height rule in the engine

sources.name: Gebäudeenergiegesetz (GEG)
sources.what: Energy rules for roofs and insulation
sources.use: Later: roof build-up and thickness

sources.name: Apache Airflow
sources.what: Workflow scheduler: tasks as code, runs, retries, logs
sources.use: Data audit and later model runs as repeatable pipelines
sources.where: not installed on the server; can run as its own stack through Portainer. Not possible natively on Windows

sources.name: DuckDB and Parquet
sources.what: Analytical database in a file
sources.use: Catalogue and feature tables without a server

sources.name: DVC
sources.what: Version control for data and models
sources.use: Reproducible datasets

sources.name: GeoPandas
sources.what: Geodata tables in Python
sources.use: Site, parcels, LoD2 footprints
sources.where: NOT installed in the Real2Twin image (inventory 31 Oct 2026); pip install geopandas pyproj in the container, or add it to the Dockerfile

sources.name: IfcOpenShell
sources.what: Read and write IFC
sources.use: Bridge to Real2Twin and Revit

sources.name: vllm and Open WebUI (team LLM)
sources.what: Shared LLM service on the server
sources.use: Explain results and read regulations; ask whether an image model is served
sources.where: runs on the server with a 0.60 GPU memory reservation; campus network or VPN only

sources.name: LoD2-DE (BKG), Germany-wide
sources.what: Nationwide LoD2 building models from the cadastre, CityGML, about 92 GB as one zip, deliverable per state
sources.use: Pitch, span and roof-type distributions for all 16 states
sources.license: free of charge under the V GeoLänder agreement; terms in the BKG documentation (to verify)

sources.name: Geofabrik OpenStreetMap extracts
sources.what: One PBF file per German state, updated daily
sources.use: Roof tags and buildings per state without the Overpass API

sources.name: Zenodo
sources.what: Open research data repository (CERN) with DOIs
sources.use: Host derived, aggregated datasets and cite them
sources.license: free; you choose the data licence

sources.name: Hugging Face Datasets
sources.what: Free hosting of datasets with git versioning
sources.use: Share Parquet datasets with the server and with others

sources.name: Apache Spark (PySpark)
sources.what: Distributed data processing; runs on one Windows machine with Java
sources.use: Mining many LoD2 tiles in parallel, partitioned by state
sources.where: locally: PySpark with Temurin JDK 21 (CPU only; GPU Spark needs Linux and RAPIDS)

sources.name: Apache Arrow and Parquet
sources.what: Columnar in-memory format and file format
sources.use: Store per-building tables, partitioned by state, read by DuckDB, Spark and pandas
sources.where: installed locally and on the server (pyarrow)
